PropertyList.title: Bell 412 "Griffen"
PropertyList.line: Winch man is only available on configurations containing the side winch and when the sliding door is open
The Floatation system is only available on specific mission configurations
Once equipped with the floatation system, the "Float Arm" button on the Collective will become available and active. Press this to ARM the system.
You should also see a red button below the Arming switch, this is the Deploy button. Click that to deploy the floats ( yes you can float on water )
The floats can be repacked and the system reset by clicking the deploy button again while on the ground.
The Autopilot is now able to control speed, altitude and heading. Autopilot is only usable between 30-140kts
Heading modes can be used without any other Autopilot function being active.
Speed modes can be used without any other Autopilot function being active.
**** Altitude modes can only be used in conjunction with speed mode being being active. This includes the use of Vertical Speed mode. ***
When disengaging the AP entirely or from a singe mode, the control inputs will snap to your actual cyclic/colective/pedal positions as soon as you move any of them.
This is unavoidable as the sim can not physically move your cyclic/colective/pedal positions to match the Autopilots input.
The best advice to minimise the sudden change of input would be for you to have your cyclic/colective/pedal positions ready in approximatly correct positions to minimise the "snap".
